author: Wrenchwise
scope: Original, provisional Lexus LS generation studies. Not approved repair replicas.

sources.title: 1990 LS400 owner/seller engine-bay photography
sources.scope: Photo of a US LHD vehicle: central V8 and intake, side air cleaner, forward battery and radiator air guide. Used only for shared visual layout; it does not establish the UK RHD brake installation or original replacement parts.

sources.title: Lexus UK 1990 LS400 launch specifications
sources.scope: Length, width excluding mirrors, height, wheelbase, track, overhangs and 1UZ-FE architecture.

sources.title: Lexus first-generation exterior archive
sources.scope: Body proportions, rectangular lamps, grille, two-tone lower trim and window outline. Multi-year gallery; individual trim details remain provisional.

sources.title: Lexus UK revised second-generation launch specifications
sources.scope: 1998 revision: nominal envelope, 2850 mm wheelbase, 1UZ-FE with VVT-i and five-speed automatic.

sources.title: Lexus 1998–2000 exterior archive
sources.scope: Revised headlamp outline, bonnet, side profile and rear silhouette.

sources.title: Lexus early LS430 exterior archive
sources.scope: Taller cabin, larger lamps, roof and side-glass outline; pre-facelift.

sources.title: Lexus Canada 2007 LS460 specifications
sources.scope: Standard wheelbase, RWD: 5030 × 1875 × 1475 mm, 2969 mm wheelbase, 18-inch wheels; not LS460L, AWD or LS600h.

sources.title: Lexus 2007–2010 LS460 exterior archive
sources.scope: Launch-era grille, swept lamps, shoulder and roof silhouette. UK photos used only as visual references for shared body shape.

sources.title: Lexus LS460 engine archive
sources.scope: Engine cover and longitudinal V8 visual arrangement; no dimensional survey.
